query:
INSERT INTO BuildStepCanCreate (drvPath, readyTime)
            SELECT $1, $2
            WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM BuildStepDeps d
                WHERE d.drvPath = $1
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM BuildSteps s
                    WHERE s.drvPath = d.depDrvPath AND s.status = 0
                  )
            )
            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
